itemUsage.en: The silent elite operator Mantra is always 'by your side' when you need her.
itemUsage.zh: 沉默的精英干员真言，必要时，她总会“陪伴”在你左右。

itemDesc.zh: 是不可言说者，也是恒久的聆听者。

description.en: Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>; enemies within Attack Range lose <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> and <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> stack limit <@ba.vdown>drops to 2</>; ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> and attacks <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</> targets at once; when Operators within range activate a skill (including Mantra), enemies within range gain {per_active} stacks of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> (can be triggered at most {max_trigger_cnt} times); for every 1 stack of <$ba.palsy>Paralysis</> <@ba.vup>above the limit</> on enemies within range, 1 instance of <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Elemental Damage jumps between the target and {chain_times} other enemy; there is a short delay between jumps

description.en:
Operator Mantra has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for suppressing the enemy with both Arts and Elemental damage.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Caster Operator during field operations to exercise Primal Caster responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.

干员真言擅长对敌人造成法术杀伤与元素杀伤
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为术师干员，行使本源术师职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en: ...Experiments with various materials were unsuccessful. Latest update: Nickel-plating the internal coil of the transmitter, again using the same method as vinyl recording, supported by my Originium Arts, in order to create the core. Mantra will equip the prototype Arts units in her next simulated mission, in order to verify its ability to reduce her burden when she 'talks'. —Whitesmith, Progress Report on the Viability Study of a Tail-Mounted Transmitter-Type Arts Unit ['Rattletail' Maintenance Log] Request: Please troubleshoot—not working properly. Maintenance Report: The internal metal plating of the transmitter-type Arts unit 'Rattletail' is badly worn, negatively affecting Arts performance. Engineering Note: I looked through the previous maintenance logs. Has no one questioned the wisdom of lugging such a heavy Arts unit around in battle? Maybe this is more in the domain of Medical, but six of these things has got to be like fifty pounds, and she's carrying all that weight on her tail. Action: Propose replacing with alternative materials to reduce weight without affecting functionality. Estimated timeframe is one month. Request: The need is urgent. Just reapply the nickel plating. Action: Nickel plating reapplied. ...... ['Rattletail' Maintenance Log] Request: Damaged in battle. Need repair urgently. Maintenance Report: All three transmitters damaged. Severe case warping. No longer operable. Engineering Note: Did she use it as a bludgeoning weapon? Guess there's one good thing that came out of all that weight. Repair is not possible: the original maker of the Arts unit is no longer in Engineering. Action: Propose building a new transmitter-type Arts unit with reference to existing research documents and the damaged prototype. Continue using metal plating, though the core structure will have to be replaced. Estimated timeframe is 3-6 months. Request: Is it possible to fully recreate the original core structure? Engineering Note: Sorry, but the unique Originium Arts used to create the original core structure cannot be fully replicated. We can only recreate the appearance and functionality to the best of our abilities. Action: Mechanist here. I have Whitesmith's documents. I'll figure something out. ... ['Central Nerve Detection Module' Maintenance Log] Request: Regular maintenance. Maintenance Report: Moderate wear to the internal metallic plating of the Central Nerve Detection Module. Engineering Note: Looks like a simple disassembly and routine maintenance job. Wouldn't have guessed how long it's been in the field if I didn't know. Operator Mantra really takes good care of it. Action: Regular full maintenance. Estimated timeframe is 2 days. Half-day rush processing possible if urgent. Request: No rush, currently on field mission. Engineering Department Note: Without your Arts unit? Request: Working with a communicator.
description.zh:
……综上所述，多种材质的尝试都以失败告终。
最新进展：尝试依旧采用唱片刻录原理，以我的源石技艺进行辅助，在发信器内部线圈的表面稳定镀镍，并制造核心。新的施术单元原型会由Mantra在下一次模拟任务中配备，以验证它能否在一定程度上减轻她“说话”的负担。
——Whitesmith，《关于尾部发信器式施术单元可行性研究的进展报告》
【“响尾”的维护日志】
需求描述：它不好用了，需要排查一下原因。
送检记录：发信器式施术单元“响尾”的内部金属镀层严重磨损，已经影响施术效果。
工程干员留言：翻了下之前的维护日志，都没人注意到她一直都带着这么重的施术单元上战场吗？虽然身体上的问题是医疗部要担心的，但把整整六个这样的玩意儿挂在尾巴上，跟用尾巴一直提着五十斤重的铅球也没什么区别了……
解决方案：倾向在不影响功能的前提下调整材质，减轻施术单元重量。预计需要时间为一个月。
需求描述：重新镀镍就行，急用。
解决方案：重新镀镍。
……
【“响尾”的维护日志】
需求描述：在战斗中损坏，需要修复。
送检记录：“响尾”的三组发信器均受损、变形严重，无法继续使用。
工程干员留言：这是直接把施术单元当成锤子用了吧？没想到它的超标重量还有这种应用场合。修复是不行了，原本制作这件施术单元的人已经不在工程部。
解决方案：倾向参考现存研究报告和已损坏原型，制作新的发信器式施术单元。可继续使用金属镀层，更换核心结构。预计需要时间为三个月到半年不等。
需求描述：是否可以完全复刻原本的核心结构？
工程干员留言：抱歉，制作原核心结构的材料中包含一种独特的源石技艺产物，目前工程部无法完全复刻，只能尽量做到外表和功能相同。
解决方案：这里是Mechanist。Whitesmith留下的文件都在我这里，我来想想办法吧。

需求描述：常规护理。
送检记录：“中枢神经探测模块”的内部金属镀层有一定磨损。
工程干员留言：看上去拆开进行常规护理就行。完全看不出来它已经使用这么久了，Mantra女士自己对它的日常护理也很到位啊。
解决方案：常规的全套护理，预计需要时间两天，可按需缩短至半天。
需求描述：在外勤任务中，不用急。
工程干员留言：咦？不带施术单元出任务吗？
需求描述：有通讯员。
